Helus Pharma has appointed Michael Halstead, former President of Intra-Cellular Therapies, as its new Chief Executive Officer to guide the company through its late-stage development and commercialization phases. The company has completed enrollment in its Phase 3 APPROACH study for HLP003, targeting Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), with topline data expected in Q4 2026. A recent Drug-Drug Interaction study showed a favorable profile for HLP003, supporting its potential as an adjunctive treatment for MDD. Additionally, Helus Pharma is progressing with its EMBRACE study and ongoing participant rollover into the EXTEND study for long-term safety data. In June 2026, the company also completed a $50 million underwritten offering to bolster its financial position for continued clinical development.
